note: Re-judged 2026-11-20 by an independent agent after 3977cef525 changed TestChildSAReplayWindowDefault. RFC 4303 Section 3.4.3: "a window size of 64 is preferred and SHOULD be employed as the default." With no window configured, createFirstChildSA installs the inbound state with ReplayWin == 64 and the outbound state with none, which the test asserts by direction; any other default on the receiving state goes red. The single-polarity annotation is sound: a default has no input a receiver must refuse, and it names installChildSA in child.go, which exists and calls installChildDataplane where the window is set. The VPP backend carries no window size (ipsec_sad_entry_v3), so the verdict covers the XFRM default path.
